avoid: Recording the receipt but leaving it unreferenced in the handoff
Treating a passed docs validate as equivalent to a bound receipt
do: Re-record the receipt whenever the doc content changes after the last validation
Reference the returned rcpt id in the handoff with --evidence-receipt and in the --proof mappings
Run pulse docs validate --record --actor <actor> after the behavior doc is final
required_checks: The handoff receipt's evidence_receipt_ids contains a documentation_validation receipt for DOC-TODOLIST-BEHAVIOR bound to the current doc content hash

summary: On Tickets with docs posture required, a handoff whose proofs do not reference a current documentation_validation receipt reads as a broken proof chain: the reviewer reworks it even when every check, QA case and doc validation actually passed. Hit on TK-004, TK-005 and TK-008; all three rework cycles were this single gap.
title: Required-docs Tickets must record and reference the documentation receipt before handoff
